style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.mon_monastery: The monastery on its peak from the pass: spiked walls and a bell tower black against the sky, red light spilling down the mountain
pictures.mon_monastery_2: Thousands of bats pouring from a belfry over a mining village's copper lights
pictures.mon_flames: A high shot from a tower: six stakes in a ring of torches and red robes in a courtyard at night

pictures.mon_flames_3: Flames and one tall silhouette, a crowd's bowed heads, a faint sulfur haze

pictures.mon_knights_tale_3: A vampire in half plate turning away from a sleeping wife

pictures.mon_hellfire_2: Candles flaring to hellfire in a cathedral
